$comment: roulette_v1 is the universal OPEN/ACTIVE state covenant. Apogee strips only the leading simc 0.7.0 pragma because its pinned in-memory frontend rejects file pragmas; the vendored body compiles to the canonical CMR 190ac19a69f2e8dc2cc24824e54c895c1d989ba75b7a01fe2a0f04ecb68fde91.
description: Verifiably random, single-bet European roulette using a player-first commitment, taker nonce, exact collateral, bounded reveal windows, and covenant-enforced payouts.

roulette_metadata_v1.placement: one-to-four consecutive RLT1 outputs immediately before TXMF; fee output last
roulette_metadata_v1.chunk_header: magic:RLT1/u8 version=1/u8 action/u8 index/u8 count/u32 round-prefix/u32 sha256(version||action||body)-prefix
roulette_metadata_v1.integer_endian: big except linked txid uses consensus byte order and linked vout uses little endian

actions.open: round_id:32 asset_id_display:32 player_p2wpkh_script:22 secret_commitment:32 bet_kind:u8 bet_selection:u8 stake:u64 bond:u64 open_expiry:u16 min_reveal_age:u16 reveal_expiry:u16 covenant_vout:u32
actions.take: round_id:32 previous_outpoint:36 house_p2wpkh_script:22 house_nonce:32 house_collateral:u64 covenant_vout:u32

roulette_open.description: Player-funded OPEN state. HOUSE_SCRIPT_HASH, HOUSE_NONCE, and HOUSE_COLLATERAL are zero.

roulette_active.description: Taken ACTIVE state, bound to the selected house P2WPKH script, nonce, and collateral.

roulette_vault.Open.description: Fund output 0 as OPEN and publish canonical RLT1 discovery metadata.

roulette_vault.Take.description: Spend OPEN at input 0, add ordinary P2WPKH house collateral, and create ACTIVE at output 0.

roulette_vault.Settle.description: Reveal the player secret after MIN_REVEAL_AGE and enforce the exact roulette payout.

roulette_vault.Cancel.description: Return an untaken OPEN amount to the player after OPEN_EXPIRY.

roulette_vault.Forfeit.description: Pay an unrevealed ACTIVE amount to the house after REVEAL_EXPIRY.

roulette_vault.ClaimPayout.description: Reblind one explicit wallet-owned terminal roulette payout using ordinary P2WPKH signing; not a covenant transition.
